request.prompt: New original 2D HAND-PAINTED Korean isometric fantasy RPG ALBINO FISHMAN (알비노 피쉬맨), NOT 3D, consistent canonical creature in all poses: pale IVORY/WHITE with light PINK scale mottling and gill stripes, large round RED fish eyes, blunt fish muzzle with small pointed teeth, attached pink-red head/dorsal/back fins, hunched upright muscular humanoid shoulders, TWO arms with webbed claw hands, TWO scaly legs with bare webbed claw feet. Bronze/brown leather torso straps/belt/bracers and ragged PURPLE-BROWN waist cloth. ONE long wooden SPEAR diagonally across torso with a dark barbed triangular metal point, coarse BROWN fishing NET draped on opposite-side forearm/hip. Spear and net continuously attached to gripping hand/arm; same equipment hand ownership in all views. No crab pincer, tail, sword, shield, horns, blue skin or human face. This is newly authored text-brief art based on documented project identity, never a recovered original game asset. Fixed orthographic 3/4 top-down game camera. EXACTLY SIXTEEN complete separated figures in FOUR columns FOUR rows. Each ROW is a direction: row1 WEST face/toes screen LEFT profile; row2 NORTHWEST face/toes up-left BACK three-quarter; row3 NORTH BACK toward viewer, dorsal fins and net nearest viewer, snout hidden and pointing TOP; row4 NORTHEAST face/toes up-right BACK three-quarter. Every row has FOUR distinct RUN phases across columns: 0 RIGHT bare webbed foot FORWARD landing, LEFT trailing; 1 RIGHT leg compression/support while LEFT knee and foot drive FORWARD airborne; 2 LEFT bare webbed foot FORWARD landing, RIGHT trailing; 3 LEFT leg compression/support while RIGHT knee/foot drive FORWARD airborne. Clearly exchange true anatomical supporting leg after column2; both webbed feet visible. Bend hips/knees/ankles, torso leans into actual direction, net and fins follow through. Back views must show true back fins and rear torso, not front face looking through body. Spear held COMPACT diagonally close to torso, never outstretched across cell. Whole actor including complete spear/net/fins SMALL INSIDE CENTRAL FORTY PERCENT OF CELL. Huge truly transparent gutters, disjoint full bounding rectangles, all parts connected, one solid silhouette per cell. No background/floor/shadow/glow/haze/text/grid/specks/particles. TRUE alpha0 outside silhouettes, no clipped body or equipment. Same anatomy/scale across all16. Save local PNG.
